subject.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages

question: Should this Feishu newline candidate stay blocked until live Feishu/Lark proof is attached, or should maintainers provide or accept another proof path for this branch?
rationale: The source-level fix looks clean after the latest revisions, but the user-visible bug depends on Feishu/Lark rendering and near-limit delivery behavior that generated payload output does not fully prove.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until a redacted Feishu/Lark screenshot, recording, API transcript, or log from this branch shows corrected rendering and no near-limit delivery failure.

options.title: Choose a canonical sibling
options.body: If a proof-positive sibling becomes conflict-free first, designate that PR as canonical and close the remaining candidates afterward.
